text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one day bug in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx occurred specifically for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary.","The bug was visible as a selected date value appearing one day behind the displayed label.","The root cause was the serialiser dropping unknown fields from the data.","The fix involved switching to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields.","The fix was implemented in PR #4489 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1.","The bug could be reproduced by selecting the first of the month and reopening the date picker.","After the fix, a job that previously took 2 hours completed in 49 minutes.","This off-by-one day issue was related to earlier similar work on the same DatePicker component."]}
